node.statement: Validated projection premise, independent of pending node 1.2. By validated node 1.2.1, P_R is Hermitian, ||P_R^2-P_R||<=t, and 1-t<=||P_R||<=1+t. Hence P_R is a t-projection and satisfies the nonvanishing alternative | ||P_R||-1 |<=t<=t+epsilon_A. This is exactly the nonvanishing t-projection premise required by lem-compcb-corner-algebra.
